html:
An art museum on Saadiyat Island in Abu Dhabi, opened in 2017. It was the first museum outside France to carry the name of the Louvre.

It came from a deal between France and the United Arab Emirates signed in 2007. Abu Dhabi pays France large sums for the use of the name until 2047 and for loans of art and expert advice from French museums. Critics in France said the national heritage was being sold.

The French architect Jean Nouvel designed it as a small town of white buildings on the water under a vast flat dome of layered steel lattice. Sunlight falling through the pattern makes what he called a rain of light.

Its galleries tell one story of world art from prehistory to now, placing objects from different cultures side by side by period instead of by region. In 2017 it was announced that the painting Salvator Mundi, attributed to Leonardo da Vinci and sold that year for a record price, would go on show there; it never did. Human rights groups criticised the treatment of migrant workers who built it.
sum: An art museum on Saadiyat Island in Abu Dhabi, opened in 2017. It was the first museum outside France to carry the name of the Louvre.
